question:
In the following triads, each letter group is related to the next letter group by following a specific logic. From the given options, choose the letter group that follows the same logic.

SONG - OSNG - GNOS

HEAT - EHAT - TAEH
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae31770e147a3fd3ecca9032d815d75b31c24312d1e30b60d1b527a90112855.png] The logic followed here is: SONG - OSNG - GNOS
